column1:
Note: "Multiplicative" values are defined as such in the files, not by me. 
These percentages are added together before multiplying. 
Example: A +30% perk and +20% perk equal a 1.5x multiplier, not 1.56x.
(Base Value + All "Additive" Modifiers) * (1 + All "Multiplicative" Modifiers)
